title: Homer's Odyssey
text: The Odyssey is one of two major ancient Greek epic poems attributed to Homer, the other being the Iliad. It follows the hero Odysseus (Ulysses in Roman literature) on his ten-year journey home to Ithaca after the fall of Troy. Along the way, Odysseus encounters mythological creatures including the Cyclops Polyphemus, the witch Circe, the Sirens, and the sea monster Scylla. The epic explores themes of homecoming, loyalty, cleverness over brute strength, and the relationship between gods and mortals. The Odyssey has profoundly influenced Western literature, inspiring works from Virgil's Aeneid to James Joyce's Ulysses. It is considered one of the foundational texts of Western civilization.
